answer: Newcomers join by neighbor quorum: five neighbors pin a plume of endorsement and lock 30 credits for 20 epochs. Endorsements sit in the public jade registry, so rented endorsers are visible. A 60-credit pearl deposit is refunded after 20 epochs; a proven sybil costs all five their stake. Renting five costs 45 each, 225 per fake; 1,000 fakes cost 225,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 185,000 loss. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps a full share.
